bio.text: Jamee Decio won the Democratic nomination for Indiana's 2nd Congressional District in May 2026 and will face Republican incumbent Rudy Yakym in November.
Decio was born and raised in Elkhart, Indiana, earned a law degree from the University of Notre Dame, and moved to California in her 30s before returning to Indiana.

sources.title: Jamee Decio wins Democratic nomination for Indiana's 2nd Congressional District
